summary: Second variant of the randomized scale+bias computation (sibling of 0x004F6850). Computes a2 * scale + bias with an optional randomization step, using the parameter pair at this+0x588 (bias) and this+0x590 (scale) instead of 0x570/0x578. Reads the enable byte at this+0x56C; when it is zero it calls the randomization helper sub_5881F0(a2) and scales a2 by the double at this+0x590, otherwise uses a2 unscaled. Adds the bias double at this+0x588 and returns the result. Called per-frame by sub_43C250 and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics.

local_names.this: physics parameter object: enable flag (this+0x56C), bias (this+0x588), scale (this+0x590)
local_names.v2: running value: a2 or a2 * scale depending on the enable flag

operations.description: Read the enable byte at this+0x56C; when it is zero, run the randomization path: call sub_5881F0(a2) then set v2 = a2 * (double at this+0x590); otherwise leave v2 = a2 unscaled.
Add the bias double at this+0x588 to the (possibly scaled) v2 to form the result.
Return the computed double. Called per-frame by sub_43C250 and SuspensionAndWheelPhysics; variant of the 0x004F6850 computation using the bias/scale pair at 0x588/0x590 instead of 0x570/0x578.

unresolved: The return value of sub_5881F0 is not captured in the decompiled body (a2 is used unchanged after the call), so it is unresolved whether the helper randomizes via side effect or via a return value lost by the decompiler.
Owner identity is unknown: the LEGACY ABI lead is the failure marker FAIL_4f6880 and provides no owner class.
